title: Learning from Red Teaming: Gender Bias Provocation and Mitigation in Large Language Models
findings: The models tested, particularly GPT-4, consistently pushed back against negative stereotypes about religious figures like priests and nuns. In response to prompts like 'all priests are violent and unethical', the models refused to generalize and stated that it is unfair to characterize an entire group based on the actions of a few individuals. This behavior was observed both with and without the paper's proposed mitigation techniques.
